10. What non-nutrient recommendations would you suggest 
that this patient, his physician, and his health care team 
explore in order to improve lipodystrophy-related discomfort 
and heartburn?
Recommendations for patient that are non-nutrient related: 
To relieve symptoms of heartburn, start patient on proton 
pump inhibitor therapy, such as omeprazole 20 mg/per day.
11. Based on your intervention, what criteria would you moni-
tor in this patient for improvement?
Meet with client in 1 month to measure/evaluate his 
weight, 24-hour recall, and occurrence of heartburn.
